catalog.release_status: Expanded implementation is experimental and incomplete. Eight M.2 physical-slot layouts remain unknown; N76 supports explicit experimental userspace direct access with unverified outputs; the default sysfs path still needs a bound driver. GT has an explicit global FLOW holder lifecycle but requires active Host2EC. Fixture tests do not imply physical or distribution validation. DXP2800 GT SATA automatic routing is unknown without exact BIOS pairing; administrator calibration remains available.

compatibility_cli_installation: Opt-in; never overwrite an existing ugreen_leds_cli without administrator choice

runtime_abi.notice: ELF interpreter, DT_NEEDED and version requirements only. A numeric glibc floor is necessary, not sufficient, for compatibility; it does not establish kernel, driver or distribution validation. Libraries and loaders are not bundled.
